help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives the slotted power a small chance to summon a Ghost that will damage enemies.  Occasionally more than one Ghost will be summoned. The rank of each Ghost is random.  The slotted power also has its recharge time reduced by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This enhancement's chance to trigger is equal to approximately 5 times per minute.
power_display_names: Superior Haunting: Recharge/Chance to summon Ghosts
